note: Other words people type for the same name (#602): build/build.py writes them into the search index, so the app's lookup stays a plain prefix match. spelling_pairs apply to every word of a species' usual name (both ways); the plural of its last word is added too, or the singular when the last word is an irregular plural. irregular_plurals maps a singular to its plural; same_plural lists words whose plural is the same word (elk keeps 'elks' as well).
